entries.referenceMarkdown:
### Turn the Blade

*A small turn of the wrist catches the blow on a waiting edge and sends it sliding past.*

Before one adjacent enemy makes a melee attack against this creature, impose 1 Bane on that attack roll. Requires a held melee weapon. Against an NPC attack, grant 1 Boon to the single defense roll instead. Applies to this attack only; it does not grant a counterattack.

details.specialtyMarkdown:
### Merciful edge

**Target:** One visible creature within 2 squares. **Player defense:** Agility. **Damage type:** radiant.

**Weak defense:** Push 3. **Standard defense:** Push 1.

**Limit:** Apply Stability, terrain costs and normal collision rules to the printed distance.

### Turn the Blade

*A small turn of the wrist catches the blow on a waiting edge and sends it sliding past.*

Before one adjacent enemy makes a melee attack against this creature, impose 1 Bane on that attack roll. Requires a held melee weapon. Against an NPC attack, grant 1 Boon to the single defense roll instead. Applies to this attack only; it does not grant a counterattack.
details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules; repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature; spend its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if capable.

**Heavy Frame — Passive:** Stability 1; an explicit trait, not a bonus calculated from Size.

**Healing:** Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Tactics and retreat:** Push an attacker away from a protected person and keep the shield ready. A credible account of unseen victims can change whom it protects.

**Encounter and conversation:** Its orders are honorable but incomplete; showing the unseen victims can change its allegiance in the dispute.

**Habitat:** Sacred boundary; refuge; contested oath · **Communication:** Common

**Loot:** Recoverable possessions or lair clues chosen for the adventure; body parts grant no automatic special equipment or coin value.

**Summoning:** Ineligible.

Use the attributes above for defenses named by incoming attacks. Same targeting, limits and costs apply; no opposed second roll.

### CV worksheet

**Reference damage:** 3/6/9

**Reference type:** radiant

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.55

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.45 → 1.55: Maneuver allowance +0, Reaction allowance +0.1. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=2.404, O=6.894. Uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/bestiary/encounters.md). Utility is provisional and does not simulate control, positioning or summon choices.

**Ability sources:** [driving blow](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/driving-blow.md), [shield hunker](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/shield-hunker.md), [Turn the Blade](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/turn-the-blade.md).

**Coverage reference:** [Pathfinder family survey](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/bestiary/family-survey.md); original HOL prose and mechanics.

# Driving Blow

*The blow lands with enough force to send its victim stumbling backward.*

## Rules

**ID:** monster-driving-blow


**Action:** Main Action

Use the printed attack. Standard pushes the target 1 square; Strong pushes it 2. Apply Stability before moving. This is a rider, not a separate attack or Force action.

**Limits:** Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed
entry values and restrictions apply; no ability grants unlisted actions.

# Shield Hunker

*The shield rises, scraping stone as its bearer crouches behind the rim.*

## Rules

**ID:** monster-shield-hunker


**Action:** Reaction

Before a shield-blockable attack resolves, spend Reaction to gain 1 defense Boon until the start of this creature’s next turn. For an NPC, apply 1 Bane to player attacks it can block instead. The DA decides whether the shield can block an attack. This stacks with Defend through ordinary Boon/Bane rules. No repeated activation adds another copy.

**Limits:** Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed
entry values and restrictions apply; no ability grants unlisted actions.
